title: [Dana-i] Large bolus causes endless 'Waiting for estimated bolus end' without actually applying bolus
body:
When I do reasonably large boluses (>15 U) AAPS regularly fails to apply the bolus. 

I am now running version 3.3.1 on Google Pixel 8 (Android 15), but it was in earlier versions and older phones as well.

When I try to apply the bolus it directly goes to 'Waiting for estimated bolus end' and will stay there for a long time.
I can also not stop the bolus anymore. Clicking the bolus will make the popup go to 'STOP PRESSED' and from there I cannot do anything anymore. I have to kill the app to continue, manually applying the bolus on my pump.

See the video

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a64fe82c-722e-4e88-8805-777175dc1fa5

I am happy to share more info, but not sure what you need
